sections.heading: Plot
sections.wikitext:
;Council Meeting
Back at the [[Huntik International HQ]] in [[Manhattan, New York]], Metz introduces the Foundation's new Seekers to the [[Huntik Foundation Council|Council]] members, who are surprised to have the son of [[Eathon Lambert]] fighting by their side. Metz also reminds them that if the Huntik Foundation wants to win against [[the Professor]], then they must put their differences aside and work together.

;An Historic Battle
As the meeting takes place, the Huntik team arrives at an underground passage in [[Thessalonica, Greece]], that leads to a room covered with burns as an indication of a major battle. Dante then uses his [[Holotome]] to recreate the battle, showing a battle between Eathon Lambert and five of the Professor's strongest operatives, who also disappeared a decade ago. Eathon was initially cornered and overwhelmed by the attacks, until he invoked Jirwolf and Dendras to turn the tide in his favor; thought the outcome of the fight was left unclear. After viewing this battle, the team head toward a door with four different pairs of stone knobs, but Lok picks the most obvious one, saying that they might not find the right answer by thinking too much.

Meanwhile, [[Rassimov]] and his Suits, still in the [[Temple of Poseidon]] on the surface, try to uncover the secret passage. One of the Suits tells Rassimov that the key must be the book that Lok had. Rassimov shows him a page of [[Eathon Lambert's journal]], given to him by [[the Professor]], which reveals the passage.

;Journey to Atlantis
[[File:Falling.jpg|175px|right]]
After passing through the door, the Huntik team find themselves on a cliff, surrounded by a bubble of oxygen. Lok and Cherit determine that it is indeed [[Atlantis]], and then they decide that they have to swim from there. While swimming, Cherit is caught by a shark, but Dante uses [[Stoneglove]] to open the shark's mouth so [[Zhalia Moon]] can get Cherit. When they reach the bubble surrounding Atlantis, they fall to the ground as Dante uses [[Featherdrop]] to catch Zhalia. Lok tries to do the same, but he misjudges her landing which results in her landing on top of him.

;The Four Tests of Casterwill
In Atlantis, they reach a compound are confronted by the Atlantis Guardian, a self-thinking magical trap who tells them they match the four great virtues of [[Lord Casterwill|Casterwill]] by passing the tests of Bravery, Prowess, intelligence, and Nobility. Lok, confronted with bravery, has to pass through flames, knowing they are false. Lok is determined to find his father and passes through the fire without any fear.[[File:S1E21_Metagolem_Mermen.png|thumb|150px|[[Metagolem]] faces the [[Mermen]]]]
Dante is then faced with the Test of Prowess and must battle three [[Mermen]] Seekers with powers of the [[Casterwill family]]. When Dante invokes [[Caliban]], the mermen each invoke a [[Caliban Ocean Warrior]] Titan. In response, Dante invokes [[Metagolem]], but the mermen counter with three powerful [[Coralgolem]] Titans while telling Dante that they can each invoke equivalent Titans to any that he summons. After his Titans get taken out, Dante calls forth [[Behemoth]]. The Mermen attempt to invoke an equivalent Titan, but an explosion is created as Dante explains that there is no equivalent to the power of a Legendary Titan. Though he passes the test, Dante collapses from exhaustion due to invoking so many powerful Titans in a short period of time.

[[Sophie Casterwill]] chooses the test of intelligence, forcing Zhalia Moon to take the final test. Her sole question is how many temples the people of Atlantis built. Remembering that this is a test of intelligence, not memory, Sophie recalls that while there were five built in Atlantis, there was also a sixth temple on the surface, the [[Temple of Poseidon]], built by the population of Atlantis as a secret passage.

Finally, Zhalia is confronted with the test of nobility. She is initially unsure of herself, thanks to her past with [[the Organization]], but it is the very confession of this past that allows her to pass the test as the real test is of inner nobleness. In regretting everything she had done, she showed herself to have a pure heart.

;Fight of Will
Having passed the tests, the [[Atlantis Guardian]] starts leading them toward the [[Amulet of Will]]. The Guardian reveals that he has not opened the gates in more than ten thousands years, which gets Lok to believe his father did not make it through the battle at the start. [[Rassimov]] then interrupts the Huntik team with a [[Darkwave]] spell to pick up the Amulet of Will. Lok is furious that he probably won't be able to find his father and channels his frustrations in fighting Rassimov one-on-one. Dante, unable to fight, tells Sophie and Zhalia to let Lok take on Rassimov while they fight his [[Suits]].

Lok makes use of the Atlantis Guardian to open the gates at the perfect timing to strike an unsuspecting Rassimov with [[Lindorm]], and the two [[Seekers]] begin invoking their respective Titans. Rassimov eventually finds an opportunity to summon [[Anubian]], but Lok is able to defeat it by ordering [[Baselaird]] to tackle it into the compound's gate, telling the Guardian to close it. Despite Lok showing a lot of resistance to Rassimov's powers, the latter manages to eventually bring him to the ground. [[Cherit]] then uses his Energy Charge to give Lok enough strenght to send Rassimov flying into a concrete wall. In the meanwhile, Sophie and Zhalia have mostly disposed of the Suits and the Organization is forced to retreat.

The team finally head to the lowest chamber of the compound, and the Atlantis Guardian explains the history of how [[Lord Casterwill]] brought the [[Titans]] to Earth to fight the [[Nullifiers]] for five hundred years, only dying when they were defeated. Lok is outside the compound, still very upset about his father not making it his far in his search for the Amulet of Will. Sophie leaves to comfort and motivate Lok to follow his father's footsteps, even if he probably won't be able to find him. Lok then returns and solves [[Eathon Lambert's puzzle|the puzzle]] Eathon left for him in the [[Tomb of Nefertiti]] to finally reveal the ancient [[Amulet of Will]] from the chamber, making the team stare at it in awe.

full_text:
Venice, Italy: Sophie Casterwill's house

Lok's father's diary, now fixed thanks to Sophie's power, leads the Huntik team to Greece looking for access to Atlantis.

Thessalonica, Greece

[[Sophie Casterwill]] chooses the test of intelligence, forcing Zhalia Moon to take the final test. Her sole question is how many temples the people of Atlantis built. Remembering that this is a test of intelligence, not memory, Sophie recalls that while there were five built in Atlantis, there was also a sixth temple on the surface, the [[Temple of Poseidon]], built by the population of Atlantis as a secret passage. Finally, Zhalia is confronted with the test of nobility. She is initially unsure of herself, thanks to her past with [[the Organization]], but it is the very confession of this past that allows her to pass the test as the real test is of inner nobleness. In regretting everything she had done, she showed herself to have a pure heart. ;Fight of Will Having passed the tests, the [[Atlantis Guardian]] starts leading them toward the [[Amulet of Will]]. The Guardian reveals that he has not opened the gates in more than ten thousands years, which gets Lok to believe his father did not make it through the battle at the start. [[Rassimov]] then interrupts the Huntik team with a [[Darkwave]] spell to pick up the Amulet of Will. Lok is furious that he probably won't be able to find his father and channels his frustrations in fighting Rassimov one-on-one. Dante, unable to fight, tells Sophie and Zhalia to let Lok take on Rassimov while they fight his [[Suits]]. Lok makes use of the Atlantis Guardian to open the gates at the perfect timing to strike an unsuspecting Rassimov with [[Lindorm]], and the two [[Seekers]] begin invoking their respective Titans. Rassimov eventually finds an opportunity to summon [[Anubian]], but Lok is able to defeat it by ordering [[Baselaird]] to tackle it into the compound's gate, telling the Guardian to close it. Despite Lok showing a lot of resistance to Rassimov's powers, the latter manages to eventually bring him to the ground. [[Cherit]] then uses his Energy Charge to give Lok enough strenght to send Rassimov flying into a concrete wall. Lok is outside the compound, still very upset about his father not making it his far in his search for the Amulet of Will. Sophie leaves to comfort and motivate Lok to follow his father's footsteps, even if he probably won't be able to find him. ;Council Meeting
Back at the [[Huntik International HQ]] in [[Manhattan, New York]], Metz introduces the Foundation's new Seekers to the [[Huntik Foundation Council|Council]] members, who are surprised to have the son of [[Eathon Lambert]] fighting by their side. Metz also reminds them that if the Huntik Foundation wants to win against [[the Professor]], then they must put their differences aside and work together.

;An Historic Battle
As the meeting takes place, the Huntik team arrives at an underground passage in [[Thessalonica, Greece]], that leads to a room covered with burns as an indication of a major battle. Dante then uses his [[Holotome]] to recreate the battle, showing a battle between Eathon Lambert and five of the Professor's strongest operatives, who also disappeared a decade ago. Eathon was initially cornered and overwhelmed by the attacks, until he invoked Jirwolf and Dendras to turn the tide in his favor; thought the outcome of the fight was left unclear. After viewing this battle, the team head toward a door with four different pairs of stone knobs, but Lok picks the most obvious one, saying that they might not find the right answer by thinking too much.

Meanwhile, [[Rassimov]] and his Suits, still in the [[Temple of Poseidon]] on the surface, try to uncover the secret passage. One of the Suits tells Rassimov that the key must be the book that Lok had. Rassimov shows him a page of [[Eathon Lambert's journal]], given to him by [[the Professor]], which reveals the passage.

;Journey to Atlantis
[[File:Falling.jpg|175px|right]]
After passing through the door, the Huntik team find themselves on a cliff, surrounded by a bubble of oxygen. Lok and Cherit determine that it is indeed [[Atlantis]], and then they decide that they have to swim from there. While swimming, Cherit is caught by a shark, but Dante uses [[Stoneglove]] to open the shark's mouth so [[Zhalia Moon]] can get Cherit. When they reach the bubble surrounding Atlantis, they fall to the ground as Dante uses [[Featherdrop]] to catch Zhalia. Lok tries to do the same, but he misjudges her landing which results in her landing on top of him.

;The Four Tests of Casterwill
In Atlantis, they reach a compound are confronted by the Atlantis Guardian, a self-thinking magical trap who tells them they match the four great virtues of [[Lord Casterwill|Casterwill]] by passing the tests of Bravery, Prowess, intelligence, and Nobility. Lok, confronted with bravery, has to pass through flames, knowing they are false. Lok is determined to find his father and passes through the fire without any fear.[[File:S1E21_Metagolem_Mermen.png|thumb|150px|[[Metagolem]] faces the [[Mermen]]]]
Dante is then faced with the Test of Prowess and must battle three [[Mermen]] Seekers with powers of the [[Casterwill family]]. When Dante invokes [[Caliban]], the mermen each invoke a [[Caliban Ocean Warrior]] Titan. In response, Dante invokes [[Metagolem]], but the mermen counter with three powerful [[Coralgolem]] Titans while telling Dante that they can each invoke equivalent Titans to any that he summons. After his Titans get taken out, Dante calls forth [[Behemoth]]. The Mermen attempt to invoke an equivalent Titan, but an explosion is created as Dante explains that there is no equivalent to the power of a Legendary Titan. Though he passes the test, Dante collapses from exhaustion due to invoking so many powerful Titans in a short period of time.

[[Sophie Casterwill]] chooses the test of intelligence, forcing Zhalia Moon to take the final test. Her sole question is how many temples the people of Atlantis built. Remembering that this is a test of intelligence, not memory, Sophie recalls that while there were five built in Atlantis, there was also a sixth temple on the surface, the [[Temple of Poseidon]], built by the population of Atlantis as a secret passage.

Finally, Zhalia is confronted with the test of nobility. She is initially unsure of herself, thanks to her past with [[the Organization]], but it is the very confession of this past that allows her to pass the test as the real test is of inner nobleness. In regretting everything she had done, she showed herself to have a pure heart.

;Fight of Will
Having passed the tests, the [[Atlantis Guardian]] starts leading them toward the [[Amulet of Will]]. The Guardian reveals that he has not opened the gates in more than ten thousands years, which gets Lok to believe his father did not make it through the battle at the start. [[Rassimov]] then interrupts the Huntik team with a [[Darkwave]] spell to pick up the Amulet of Will. Lok is furious that he probably won't be able to find his father and channels his frustrations in fighting Rassimov one-on-one. Dante, unable to fight, tells Sophie and Zhalia to let Lok take on Rassimov while they fight his [[Suits]].

Lok makes use of the Atlantis Guardian to open the gates at the perfect timing to strike an unsuspecting Rassimov with [[Lindorm]], and the two [[Seekers]] begin invoking their respective Titans. Rassimov eventually finds an opportunity to summon [[Anubian]], but Lok is able to defeat it by ordering [[Baselaird]] to tackle it into the compound's gate, telling the Guardian to close it. Despite Lok showing a lot of resistance to Rassimov's powers, the latter manages to eventually bring him to the ground. [[Cherit]] then uses his Energy Charge to give Lok enough strenght to send Rassimov flying into a concrete wall. In the meanwhile, Sophie and Zhalia have mostly disposed of the Suits and the Organization is forced to retreat.

The team finally head to the lowest chamber of the compound, and the Atlantis Guardian explains the history of how [[Lord Casterwill]] brought the [[Titans]] to Earth to fight the [[Nullifiers]] for five hundred years, only dying when they were defeated. Lok is outside the compound, still very upset about his father not making it his far in his search for the Amulet of Will. Sophie leaves to comfort and motivate Lok to follow his father's footsteps, even if he probably won't be able to find him. Lok then returns and solves [[Eathon Lambert's puzzle|the puzzle]] Eathon left for him in the [[Tomb of Nefertiti]] to finally reveal the ancient [[Amulet of Will]] from the chamber, making the team stare at it in awe.
